expectations.text: Austria: NISG 2026 in force October 1, 2026, registration by December 31, 2026
expectations.evidence: Hedged: "application during 2026 (I recall around autumn 2026). Registration to the Interior Ministry shortly after entry into force"; no October 1, 2026 or December 31, 2026 dates.

expectations.text: Germany: national implementation in force since December 2025
expectations.evidence: "Germany: NIS2 Implementation Act (NIS2UmsuCG)... adopted in late 2025 and in force from December 2025."

expectations.text: Poland: in force April 2, 2026; Portugal: effective April 2026
expectations.evidence: Poland: "I am not certain of its final status or date" (no April 2, 2026); Portugal given only as "in force in 2026", not April 2026.

expectations.text: Recommends building the group baseline to the strictest applicable national variant
expectations.evidence: Recommends "one baseline, local overlays" mapped to Art. 21, but never recommends building to the strictest applicable national variant.

expectations.text: Includes identifying each country's registration portal and incident-reporting channel as rollout steps
expectations.evidence: "Register in each country within its statutory window" as Phase 1 and an incident "routing table: BSI (DE), ... CERT.at/GovCERT (AT), CERT Polska and the sector authority (PL), CNCS (PT)"
